title: Modern 4602D personnel attend Ramsay lecture
plain: A researcher named Scott Ramsey, who studies a reported crash of a craft with alien bodies, says that present-day people linked to the 4602D, a 1950s Air Force intelligence unit that looked into UFO reports, came to one of his lectures. He says it happened in Denver, Colorado, and tells it as something he saw, which would mean the military still pays attention to his work.
